name: ai-scraping-executor
description: AI Web Scraping Executor — plataforma agnóstica de scraping asistida por IA (Crawlee + NestJS)

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build -w api && npm run build -w worker
scripts.build:core: npm run build -w @ai-scraper/core && npm run build -w @ai-scraper/security && npm run build -w @ai-scraper/observability && npm run build -w @ai-scraper/commands && npm run build -w @ai-scraper/crawler && npm run build -w @ai-scraper/execution-engine && npm run build -w @ai-scraper/ai && npm run build -w @ai-scraper/ai-providers && npm run build -w @ai-scraper/mongodb && npm run build -w @ai-scraper/redis && npm run build -w @ai-scraper/storage && npm run build -w @ai-scraper/queue
scripts.build:all: npm run build:core && npm run build -w api && npm run build -w worker
scripts.test: node --test --test-concurrency=1 --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-lines=70 --test-coverage-branches=72 --test-coverage-functions=67 --test-coverage-include="packages/*/dist/**/*.js" --test-coverage-include="apps/*/dist/**/*.js" --test-coverage-exclude="**/*.module.js" --test-coverage-exclude="**/main.js" --test-coverage-exclude="**/dto/**" tests/dsl.test.mjs tests/engine.test.mjs tests/crawler.test.mjs tests/ai-providers.test.mjs tests/agent.test.mjs tests/persistence.test.mjs tests/dashboard.test.mjs tests/security.test.mjs tests/browser.test.mjs tests/api-hardening.test.mjs tests/observability.test.mjs tests/scale.test.mjs tests/normalize.test.mjs tests/llm-cache.test.mjs tests/interpret.test.mjs tests/resilience.test.mjs tests/sessions.test.mjs tests/credentials.test.mjs tests/cache-isolation.test.mjs tests/limits.test.mjs tests/first-user.test.mjs tests/logging.test.mjs tests/util-unify.test.mjs tests/metrics-labels.test.mjs tests/retry-cleanup.test.mjs tests/browser-ssrf.test.mjs
scripts.dev:e2e: docker compose up -d postgres mongodb redis && sleep 10 && npm run prisma:migrate:deploy && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
